# Hi, I'm Basit 👋

Senior full stack engineer in Toronto. I build payment, banking and SaaS platforms, mostly in **PHP and Laravel**, with **WordPress**, **Python**, **Node.js** and **React** alongside.
Currently a senior web developer at a Toronto fintech. Outside work I build tools with LLMs, games and trading systems.

🌐 **Portfolio:** [naijabas.github.io](https://naijabas.github.io)

## Side projects

**🤖 AI-powered CV tailoring Chrome extension** · Claude API, JavaScript<br>
Parses an uploaded CV and uses Claude to suggest changes tailored to a role. Multi-step agent logic, dynamic prompts, context window management, retries and fallbacks for unreliable model output, and structured extraction from LLM responses.

**🇫🇷 Français OS** · Laravel 12, Livewire, Pest, MariaDB<br>
My own trainer for the TCF Canada French exam: a daily study plan that re-plans itself after missed days, spaced repetition built from my mistakes, timed exam practice from randomised question banks, and AI grading of writing and speaking with a hard monthly budget.

**🃏 Multiplayer Nigerian Whot** · Node.js, React, Firebase<br>
Real-time multiplayer version of the Whot card game, with game state kept in sync across players and a full rule engine: turns, card validation, special cards and win detection.

**📈 USDCAD algorithmic trading Expert Advisor**<br>
Automated mean-reversion strategy on the 15-minute chart using RSI and Bollinger Bands, with ATR-based stop losses, dynamic position sizing, session filters and a guard that pauses after consecutive losses.

## Freelance and contract work

**USSD apps** for local and rural communities in Nigeria, used by 20,000+ people · **PASTECS**, class management software for tutors and institutions, built in a team of six · fintech, investment and e-commerce apps for clients including Itrustinvestment, Olooja Store and Binarex · a CRM used by 1,000+ real estate agents and brokerages.

Wallet, debit card and insurance APIs at **KrediBank** · **Unionmall**, an internal WooCommerce store for Union Bank staff with core banking payment and Active Directory integration · **WinsusuPay**, a mobile savings platform · **Artgidi**, a digital art marketplace, front end and API · enterprise HR software at **Timoltech**, used by 2,000+ UK companies.
